step1.title: Welcome to WalletWise!
step1.description: WalletWise helps you track your weekly budget. Stay on top of your finances by knowing exactly where your money goes.

step2.title: Plannings
step2.description: A planning is a separate budget — like personal finances, a trip, or a project. Plannings are not linked to bank accounts, and you can have as many as you need.

step3.title: Periods and transactions
step3.description: WalletWise organizes your finances into weekly periods. Add transactions and periods are created automatically, so you always know your balance for the current week.

step4.title: You're almost done...
step4.description: Let's start with your first planning. Choose a name and the currency you'll be using.
